== English errata comparison sources ==
The 1998 Glossary changes deployment ownership, names the eligible targets and sets defense value as the comparison. The paragraph about transfers that follows is a ruling. The Dark Side card has its own comparison.

* Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=36|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 36.
* Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=107|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 107.
